data_supported_conclusion: 측정치(proxy hurdle + 계약 실측 병기): CAGR 12.1% (BM 대비 +1.3%p), 샤프 0.60, MDD -64.4%, IR 0.09, 회전율 연 664%, OOS retention 1.06 | 실측(backtested): essence F, PORT_t(NW lag-3) 0.30, OOS_ret -1.13.
